text:
I didn't go to this clinic to use their service, but saw an ad on Facebook and wanted to share with you my story. I had my ink removed on my four fingers in Canada. The total sessions were 2 visits. I was supposed to go one more time, but I was happy with the result and didn't go on the 3rd and final session. The cost per session was about $100-$120 CAD, but that was over 15 years ago. I wouldn't pay more than 10,000 baht for some small black and white tattoos in Canada or Thailand. Big, colorful tattoos will need a lot more sessions and cost more.

Also note, the tattoos I had on my four fingers were done by hand. So the ink probably didn't go too deep into my skin and came off more easily than machine-done tattoos. Maybe that's why I needed 2 sessions.

The guy below me was asked to come for 12 sessions. So I think that's a rip off, for only black ink WITHOUT color. It worked for 2 sessions on me, plus technology should have improved since I had mine removed 15 years ago. I think even color tattoos don't need 12 sessions, unless it's a really big ink.
